text: 1. Have the nationality of a country participating in the "Belt and Road Initiative" and hold a valid foreign ordinary passport; 2. Friendly towards China, healthy and physically fit; 3. Have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, be diligent and eager to learn, and have no violations of Chinese laws and regulations or school rules and regulations. 4. Applicants for doctoral studies should be no older than 40 years; applicants for master's studies should be no older than 35 years; applicants for undergraduate studies should be no older than 30 years; applicants for non-degree Chinese language training in China can be up to 45 years old (age is calculated as of September 1, 2025). 5. No other scholarships were received.
